title: Ingo Swann sees a non-human woman at a supermarket
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Ingo Swann sees a non-human woman at a supermarket, about 1970s at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about Penetration, a book by Ingo Swann, a famous remote viewer, meaning someone who claimed to see distant places with the mind, and who was there at the start of the US government's psychic spying programme. Michels says that halfway through the book Swann describes being at a supermarket and seeing one of them, a being who looked like a woman but was not human. If true, it would mean non-humans walk among us in ordinary places.
